findings.title: CI format gate fails on the reviewed head: application_integration_test.gleam unformatted
findings.evidence:
let assert Ok(entry) =
    list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })

$ gleam format --check test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam
> error: These files have not been formatted
>   - test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam

(repo-wide --check: only this file fails; CI run 31232168072 on head a55481e fails the 'Format, Lint, Unit Test & Build' job at the format step)
findings.detail: The new list_endpoint_renders_viewed_status_test binds a let-assert across two lines; gleam format wants it joined. The repo's mandatory pre-PR format gate (AGENTS.md) is red on the exact reviewed sha, blocking merge. Introduced by the r2 fix commit itself.
findings.recommended_fix: Run `gleam format server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam`, commit, push — the new sha earns a fresh round.

findings.title: Client reducer ApiReturnedStatusUpdate 'viewed' arm has no client-unit test
findings.evidence:
"viewed" -> application.Viewed
...case has a silent `_ -> app.status` fallback; grep of client/test/ finds no test dispatching ApiReturnedStatusUpdate for any status.
findings.detail: The case has a silent fallback, so a regressed/missing viewed arm would not fail compilation. Integration covers the server path only; the reducer mapping is unobserved at client level.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a client-unit test dispatching ApiReturnedStatusUpdate(Ok("viewed")) and asserting the detail status becomes Viewed.

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.evidence: P0=100% (codec round-trip x5, parse_status, PATCH->viewed+audit, list-endpoint B1 pin, 400 body, stepper math x5, pill render x2, comparison CTA, sort rank). P1 ~85%: only gap is the reducer client-unit test. Overall ~87%.
findings.detail: All r1 coverage gaps closed; one small test (finding #2) lifts P1 to >=90% and clears the gate. Not a merge blocker.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the reducer client-unit test; re-run the gate.

findings.title: focus_index_for_status omits 'submitted' (no focus mapping for stop 0)
findings.evidence:
case slug {
  "under_review" -> Some(rank(application.UnderReview) - 1)
  "shortlisted" -> Some(rank(application.Shortlisted) - 1)
  "viewed" -> Some(rank(application.Viewed) - 1)
  "approved" -> Some(rank(application.Approved) - 1)
  _ -> None
}
findings.detail: Pre-existing since the 4-stop pipeline, and unreachable today: the only call site (client.gleam:3158) passes PATCH-returned statuses, and parse_status can never return 'submitted'. Latent drift, not a live defect.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: add `"submitted" -> Some(0)` for symmetry; not required for merge.

findings.detail: The ')' has no opening paren; pre-existing from 'six values).' and carried forward when this diff updated the count to seven.

findings.title: Integration tests use raw SQL string interpolation (test-only)
findings.evidence: test_db.query_text(db, "SELECT status::text FROM application WHERE id = '" <> app_id <> "'::uuid")
findings.detail: Test-only concatenation of seed-generated UUIDs against the local Docker DB; production uses Squirrel parameterized queries exclusively. No production pattern modeled.
findings.recommended_fix: Accept as test convenience; flag if the idiom ever migrates to non-test code.

findings.title: List handler duplicates status_from_string with its own inline string->enum case
findings.detail: r1's B1 happened exactly because this inline case missed an arm added to the shared function. The unknown-warning log is the only behavioral difference; future enum additions remain at drift risk.
findings.recommended_fix: Consider wrapping status_from_string with an unknown-guard for the log, removing the arm-count mismatch surface.

rejected_findings.title: slug_for_index wildcard silently maps out-of-range indices to 'approved'
rejected_findings.reason: False positive: slug_for_index is `case clamp_focus(index)` — clamp_focus bounds to 0..4 before the case, so the `_ ->` wildcard can only ever receive 4. The claimed 'corrupt index >=5' path is unreachable; behavior is correct for the 5-stop pipeline.
